title: DR-18: external join checks own leaf before building
description: OpenMLS exposes no staged external Commit before finalize stores it. Member::join_external checks the joiner's own leaf against the required safe_aad/app_components lists (DR-15b) using the GroupContext from the verified GroupInfo, before building. An external Commit carries only ExternalInit plus an optional resync Remove, so the post-Commit lists equal the pre-Commit ones and DR-15c (mimid-1wgh.4.49) still holds. finalize merges immediately; a hub-rejected external Commit cannot be rolled back and the caller drops the Member (documented).
